about: What SpawnLoft records about the jars and packs it installed, which update checks compare against: the plugin store and the modpack record in a server folder, and the client's mods record. Hand-dropped jars have no record and are never offered updates. test/contracts-files.test.mjs writes the plugin store through plugins.mjs and holds the other writers against the source.

pluginStore.file: <server>/plugins/.mcctl-plugins.json, or <server>/mods/.mcctl-plugins.json on a mod loader (contentKindFor): inside the folder so backups carry it
pluginStore.text: util.mjs writeJson; { version: 1, managed: { <jar file name>: record } }, jars in the order they were first recorded; a rename moves the record to the new name at the end; a removal deletes it

modpack.note: install and update write the same keys; files is every path the pack laid down (index files, then overrides/, then server-overrides/), which an update removes before laying the new version
